channel.title: Pier & Point · Piers 38 & 40
channel.description: Changes, corrections and dated milestones for Piers 38 & 40 (Mission Rock), San Francisco. Every item names its source.

item.title: Correction · Piers 38 & 40: Long 'At a glance' values were cut to the fact itself (or 'Sources…
item.description: Long 'At a glance' values were cut to the fact itself (or 'Sources differ'); the disputes, quoted excerpts and hedging moved to this record's open questions, with every source still named. No change to the record's status or shape. Source: Pier & Point's own text edit.

item.title: Correction · Piers 38 & 40: The summary for Piers 38 & 40 now includes Aug 12, 2026 report that…
item.description: The summary for Piers 38 & 40 now includes Aug 12, 2026 report that the piers are offered for lease. Source: https://news.theregistrysf.com/pacific-cornerstone-brings-280000-sqft-piers-38-40-waterfront-redevelopment-to-market-for-long-term-lease-in-san-francisco/.

item.title: Correction · Piers 38 & 40: The Piers 38 & 40 page now explains that 'planned' means proposed…
item.description: The Piers 38 & 40 page now explains that 'planned' means proposed only: the Port's April 2026 staff report says the term sheet was never executed and that negotiations on transaction documents are suspended for twelve months to evaluate feasibility; environmental review and a lease are still future benchmarks. Source: Port Commission Item 9B staff report, April 28, 2026 (sfport.com/sites/default/files/2026-04/item_9b_piers_38_and_40_amended_ena_and_related_settlement_agreements.docx.pdf).
item.source: Port Commission Item 9B staff report, April 28, 2026 (sfport.com/sites/default/files/2026-04/item_9b_piers_38_and_40_amended_ena_and_related_settlement_agreements.docx.pdf)

item.title: Correction · Piers 38 & 40: The Piers 38 & 40 page now follows the Port's April 2026 memo on who…
item.description: The Piers 38 & 40 page now follows the Port's April 2026 memo on who is whose affiliate, describes the $980,000 as an unpaid balance including late charges and interest, and labels the $528-536 million and $383 million figures as estimates from 2022 reporting. Source: Port Commission Item 9B memo, 2026-04-24, Resolutions 26-21 and 26-22; The Real Deal, 2022-07-14; SF Chronicle, 2022-06-02; Port of San Francisco project page; The Registry SF, 2026-08-12.

item.title: Correction · Piers 38 & 40: Piers 38 and 40 now sit on the two real decks
item.description: Piers 38 and 40 now sit on the two real decks. Their outline had been one rough box that also covered the water between them. The new outlines are traced by hand from satellite imagery, so they are still approximate. Source: Satellite imagery, Pier & Point's own reading (Esri World Imagery, captured 2025-08-29).
item.source: Satellite imagery, Pier & Point's own reading (Esri World Imagery, captured 2025-08-29)

item.title: Correction · Piers 38 & 40: Pier 38 and Pier 40 each have their own Assessor lot (9900038 and…
item.description: Pier 38 and Pier 40 each have their own Assessor lot (9900038 and 9900040). This record had said they had none, because the search used to check looked for street names and Port piers do not have one. The outlines on the map are unchanged: they are still hand traces of the two pier decks. Source: DataSF, Parcels - Active and Retired (acdm-wktn), the rows for Assessor lots 9900038 and 9900040, queried 2026-10-10.
item.source: DataSF, Parcels - Active and Retired (acdm-wktn), the rows for Assessor lots 9900038 and 9900040, queried 2026-10-10

item.title: Added · Piers 38 & 40: New nearby-project record for Piers 38 & 40, next to Mission Rock
item.description: New nearby-project record for Piers 38 & 40, next to Mission Rock. The original 2021 Exclusive Negotiating Agreement lapsed in 2023; in April 2026 the Port Commission settled a related back-rent dispute and adopted an Amended and Restated agreement with a 12-month evaluation period. Source: Port of San Francisco, Commission Item 9B, Piers 38 and 40 Amended and Restated ENA and Related Settlement Agreements, 2026-04-28 (https://www.sfport.com/sites/default/files/2026-04/item_9b_piers_38_and_40_amended_ena_and_related_settlement_agreements.docx.pdf).
item.source: Port of San Francisco, Commission Item 9B, Piers 38 and 40 Amended and Restated ENA and Related Settlement Agreements, 2026-04-28 (https://www.sfport.com/sites/default/files/2026-04/item_9b_piers_38_and_40_amended_ena_and_related_settlement_agreements.docx.pdf)

item.title: Milestone · Piers 38 & 40: The Registry SF publishes a teaser (the rest is behind a… (Aug 12, 2026)
item.description: The Registry SF publishes a teaser (the rest is behind a paywall) saying the piers "are being offered for long-term lease to major credit tenants, positioning up to 279,876 square feet of San Francisco waterfront space for occupancy in late 2029"; the headline names Pacific Cornerstone. The readable part does not say who authorized the listing or how it relates to the Port's Evaluation Period, and it is not a confirmed lease or Port-approved deal. (Aug 12, 2026). Source: The Registry SF, 2026-08-12.

item.title: Milestone · Piers 38 & 40: Port Commission adopts a Settlement Agreement… (Apr 28, 2026)
item.description: Port Commission adopts a Settlement Agreement (Resolution 26-21: Pacific Waterfront Partners to pay $720,000 over 3 years, with the remaining debt forgiven on compliance) and an Amended and Restated ENA (Resolution 26-22: a 12-month "Evaluation Period" for the developer to pursue value engineering, project phasing and a new financial partner, with a new Schedule of Performance due before the period ends; Resolution 26-22 says within twelve months after execution of the Amended ENA, and the execution date is not in the sources read, so the end falls roughly in April 2027 if it was signed soon after adoption). (Apr 28, 2026). Source: Port of San Francisco / Port Commission, 2026-04-28.
item.source: Port of San Francisco / Port Commission, 2026-04-28

item.title: Milestone · Piers 38 & 40: Pacific Waterfront Partners (an SFWP affiliate) vacates… (Jan 31, 2024)
item.description: Pacific Waterfront Partners (an SFWP affiliate) vacates three unrelated Port leases (Pier 28 and two Agriculture Building suites) and the Port accepts surrender. As of the Port's April 2026 memo it owes an outstanding balance of unpaid rent, late charges, fees and interest of approximately $980,000 ("in excess of $980,000" in the memo; "approximately $980,000" in Resolution 26-21). (Jan 31, 2024). Source: Port of San Francisco / Port Commission, 2026-04-28.
item.source: Port of San Francisco / Port Commission, 2026-04-28

item.title: Milestone · Piers 38 & 40: The original Exclusive Negotiating Agreement expires… (Mar 15, 2023)
item.description: The original Exclusive Negotiating Agreement expires (Port memo: "The Original ENA expired on March 15, 2023"). The memo separately says that, as of April 2026, the developer "is currently out of compliance with the ENA due to missed Performance Dates"; it does not date the missed dates. (Mar 15, 2023). Source: Port of San Francisco / Port Commission, 2026-04-28.
item.source: Port of San Francisco / Port Commission, 2026-04-28

item.title: Milestone · Piers 38 & 40: Port Commission Resolution 22-36 endorses a Term Sheet… (Jul 12, 2022)
item.description: Port Commission Resolution 22-36 endorses a Term Sheet (never executed) describing the project's then-scope: visitor-serving restaurant/retail, maritime uses including South Beach Harbor expansion and youth sailing, retained Pier 40 marina tenants, public access/open space, and revenue-generating office space. (Jul 12, 2022). Source: Port of San Francisco / Port Commission, 2026-04-28; The Real Deal, 2022-07-14.
item.source: Port of San Francisco / Port Commission, 2026-04-28; The Real Deal, 2022-07-14

item.title: Milestone · Piers 38 & 40: Port Commission Resolution 21-10 authorizes an Exclusive… (Feb 23, 2021)
item.description: Port Commission Resolution 21-10 authorizes an Exclusive Negotiating Agreement (dated 2021-03-12) with San Francisco Waterfront Partners III, LLC. (Feb 23, 2021). Source: Port of San Francisco / Port Commission, 2026-04-28.
item.source: Port of San Francisco / Port Commission, 2026-04-28
